result:
Admins can now change a user's role from a select in each row of the users table. I haven't run tests, lint or the app, so none of this has been checked.

- **API:** `features/users/api/update-user-role.ts` sends `PATCH /users/{userId}/role` with `{ role }`. The `role` value is validated by a Zod schema (`ADMIN` or `USER`).
- **Role shows after the change:** on success the hook invalidates the `['users']` query, so the list refetches and shows the new role.
- **Success message:** the hook shows a "User Role Updated" notification. I put it in the `api/` hook because `features/CLAUDE.md` says success notifications belong there, not in components. The existing delete component still shows its notification itself, so it doesn't follow that rule.
- **UI:** `features/users/components/update-user-role.tsx` is the new select, wired into the Role column of `users-list.tsx`.
- **Own row:** your own row shows plain text instead of a select, so you can't demote yourself.
- **Select element:** I used a native `<select>` because the shared `Select` component only works with react-hook-form registration.
- **Mock API:** I added a matching MSW handler in `testing/mocks/handlers/users.ts`. It requires an admin and only updates users in the caller's team.
- **No tests:** I didn't add any, since you asked me not to run them.
